comments.body: Hi, can you squash your commits into 1?
all commits must be signed `git commit -s` for our project.  if you squash the commits to one, then perhaps a `git commit --amend -s` would suffice?
Personally, I'd vote to keep it, but that's just my $.02
I'd also vote to keep this around; if it's an active flag, it's good to have it documented imo.
